group.name: hoursAndRate
group.midi.doc: The hours byte: 0rrhhhhh (the frame rate and the hours).

field.name: FrameRate
field.midi.doc: 0: 24 fps; 1: 25 fps; 2: 30 fps drop frame; 3: 30 fps non-drop.

group.name: FullMessage
group.midi.doc: Full Message (7F 01 01): a complete time code position, e.g. when locating.

group.name: UserBits
group.midi.doc: User Bits (7F 01 02): the SMPTE user bits.

field.name: UserBits
field.midi.doc: The 8 nibbles of the user bits (0000aaaa ... 0000hhhh).

group.name: Setup
group.midi.doc: Set-up (7E 04): sets up cueing points and events at a time code position, ahead of time.

field.name: Type
field.midi.doc: The type of event (sub-ID#2): 00: special; 01: punch in points; 02: punch out points; 03: delete punch in point; 04: delete punch out point; 05: event start points; 06: event stop points; 07: event start points with additional info; 08: event stop points with additional info; 09: delete event start point; 0A: delete event stop point; 0B: cue points; 0C: cue points with additional info; 0D: delete cue point; 0E: event name in additional info.

field.name: EventNumber
field.midi.doc: The event number (with type 00: the special type).

field.name: AdditionalInfo
field.midi.doc: Additional information (nibblized MIDI messages, or the event name).

group.name: Cueing
group.midi.doc: Real Time Cueing (7F 05): an event that happens now.
